violations.description: Complete absence of CI/CD workflows and automated testing configuration
violations.evidence: No GitHub Actions workflows or CI/CD configuration files exist in the repository (.github/workflows is absent).
violations.recommendation: Implement CI/CD workflows (e.g., GitHub Actions) to automate linting, testing, and security scanning on pull requests and pushes.

violations.description: Unpinned third-party binary download and pip package installation in installation script
violations.evidence: Script installs gitleaks via unpinned latest release download (`wget $latest`) and installs python packages via `pip install detect-secrets truffleHog` without version pinning.
violations.recommendation: Pin tool versions and package versions, and verify cryptographic checksums (hashes) of downloaded binaries before execution.

violations.description: Absence of dependency manifest or package manager configuration
violations.evidence: No package manager manifests (package.json, requirements.txt, pyproject.toml, go.mod, etc.) exist in the repository root or subdirectories.
violations.recommendation: If the repository requires dependencies for its scripts (such as benchmark.py), declare them in an appropriate dependency manifest file.

violations.description: Absence of automated tests for codebase or scripts
violations.evidence: No unit tests, integration tests, or test suite configuration exist for the repository scripts (e.g., benchmark.py).
violations.recommendation: Add unit testing for any automation scripts to ensure reliability and correctness.
